svg.title: K04: the Service selector does not match the Pod labels
svg.desc: The visitor reaches the Service tools. The Service looks for Pods labelled tier=frontend. The two tools Pods are labelled tier=backend, so no Pod matches, the endpoint list is empty and the request goes nowhere. The fix is to select tier=backend.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A Service finds its Pods only through labels

svg.text: Pods and Service are both healthy. They simply do not agree on one label.

svg.text: Every Pod is Running. Every request fails. kubectl get endpointslices shows ENDPOINTS <unset>.

svg.text: Change the Service selector to tier: backend (the label the Pods carry). No Pod restarts.
